# The pnpm release binaries `.github/actions/pnpm` installs, from
# https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tag/v10.25.0. Each is self-contained: it bundles its own
# Node.js, so nothing here needs a package manager to install a package manager.
#
# On a pnpm bump, change `packageManager` in package.json, then regenerate every line:
#
#   v=10.25.0
#   for a in pnpm-linux-x64 pnpm-linux-arm64 pnpm-macos-x64 pnpm-macos-arm64 pnpm-win-x64.exe; do
#     curl -fsSL "https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/download/v$v/$a" | sha256sum | sed "s|-|$a|"
#   done
#
# version 10.25.0
